messages:
alice.p: starting offsite transport validation window (02:00-03:00 UTC) for private bundle v1.9.2. Need final sign-off on cosign key rotation, shrinkwrap manifest, and backout plan before we hand off to logistics.
ben_k: checking: images are pinned to digest? i saw some refs with :latest in the staging manifest earlier.
packaging-bot: bundle built: s3://redwood-offsite/bundles/v1.9.2.tgz (sha256: 3f4b7c9a...). shrinkwrap manifest: s3://redwood-offsite/manifests/v1.9.2-shrink.json (sha256: a1d2c3e4). All images pinned to digest in shrinkwrap.
carla-rl: good. can we get cosign signatures for the image set and the shrinkwrap? need verification steps for the transfer team.
packaging-bot: cosign signatures pushed to keyring: cosign://redwood/cosign-rotations/2026-08. Command to verify:```bash
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/cosign-2026-08 \
  -signature signatures/v1.9.2.sig \
  shrinkwrap/v1.9.2-shrink.json
```
alice.p: also include the airgap submanifest that the on-prem installer will consume. It's under: s3://redwood-offsite/submanifests/vpc-v1.9.2.yaml
ben_k: noted. ops-oncall, are you comfortable with proposed rollback window (03:00-03:30 UTC) and the manual backout steps?
ops-oncall: yes, rollback window reserved 03:00-03:30 UTC. Backout plan: 1) abort transport (cancel rsync/transfer), 2) redeploy previous shrinkwrap (v1.9.1) to staging nodes, 3) trigger installer rollback flow. Manual commands in a pinch:```bash
# revert cluster images to v1.9.1 manifest
installer-admin --env prod --apply-manifest s3://redwood-offsite/manifests/v1.9.1-shrink.json --force
# or kubectl image rollback example
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deployment/web --to-revision=42
```
carla-rl: for the installer rollback, we should also pin the KV cache migration to off in the rollback path, otherwise old nodes might try to read new cache format. Add flag: `--kv-migration=false`.
release-mgr: documented in release notes draft: "Private bundle v1.9.2 — airgap submanifest, cosign rotation 2026-08, shrinkwrap enforced. Change window 02:00-03:30 UTC; rollback 03:00-03:30 UTC if anomalies." I'll push to the release-notes repo after approvals.
deploy-bot: deploy event: canary-stage started for onprem-staging using v1.9.2 at 2180123465 — health checks OK (3/3). Link: https://ci.redwood/internal/deploys/2180123465
ben_k: can we run an integrity check on the delivered bundle before handing to transport? quick script:```bash
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-offsite/bundles/v1.9.2.tgz ./v1.9.2.tgz && sha256sum v1.9.2.tgz | grep 3f4b7c9a
# validate shrinkwrap signatures
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/cosign-2026-08 signatures/v1.9.2.sig shrinkwrap/v1.9.2-shrink.json
```
ops-oncall: add a post-delivery checksum verification step for the receiving site. they should run the same sha256 and cosign verify and post back the result to this thread before unpacking.
carla-rl: one more: if transport fails mid-transfer, we should have a delta-manifest approach instead of retransferring whole bundle. packaging-bot, can you produce a delta payload for the main images?
packaging-bot: delta payload generated: s3://redwood-offsite/deltas/v1.9.1-to-1.9.2.patch (size 120MB). Transport team can apply the patch after verifying signatures.
alice.p: ok — final checklist before handoff: 1) cosign verify ok, 2) shrinkwrap sha matches, 3) airgap submanifest present, 4) delta payload available, 5) rollback window reserved. Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.
release-mgr: approved :white_check_mark:. I'll update customers and logistics.
ben_k: verified sha and cosign locally :white_check_mark:.
carla-rl: added `--kv-migration=false` to rollback docs and flagged in ops runbook :white_check_mark:.
ops-oncall: rollback window confirmed in calendar and standby pager assigned :white_check_mark:.
packaging-bot: transfer ticket created: #TR-4021. ETA handoff to transport team at 02:05 UTC.
deploy-bot: canary monitoring: latency spike at 2180123570 on one canary node, 250ms->580ms for token gen, investigating.
alice.p: noted — if any canary fails health for >2m we abort transport and initiate backout. ops-oncall, be ready to trigger.
ops-oncall: ack, standing by.
packaging-bot: transport started at 2180123578 (rsync -> transport gateway).
release-mgr: I'll wait for transport confirmation and post-release notes link after successful delivery.
deploy-bot: canary healthy again at 2180123585. No action required.
alice.p: excellent — handing off to transport. keep this thread for post-delivery checksum confirmations.
